feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed. The best raced design is iteration 6 (909.8): kp 2.25, kd 1.2, base 1.2, sensors at +/-3 cm with 16 mm footprints. It finishes the oval 20/20 and the s-bend 20/20. On the slalom it finishes 16/20, with 4 off-track ends, 0.2 line-loss events, rms 0.012 m and steering oscillation 0.26. Iteration 3 (kd 0.9) had the same slalom finish count, so the kd increase was a small gain, not a fix. Iteration 5 showed that kp 3.0 with a wider spread cut slalom finishes to 14/20 and raised control effort to 8.0. Higher kp therefore looks like the wrong direction for the slalom.

The candidate is valid and is a clean single-variable change from iteration 6: kp 2.25 to 2.0, with kd 1.2, base 1.2, ki 0, geometry and sensor layout unchanged. Its line-loss and oscillation evidence is consistent with overshoot on the tightest bends, not a lost line. Oscillation is low, and line loss is at 0.2 per slalom run. The race will test whether softer proportional action cuts the slalom off-track exits. Approve now: the change is well grounded, and the remaining budget is better spent on the race and the next iteration than on a further review round.

Read the next race this way. If the slalom finish rate reaches 0.85 or more and the slalom mean rises above iteration 6's 829, keep kp 2.0. If the slalom line_loss_events rise above 0.3 or the finish rate falls, the proportional gain has become too weak to hold the line, so return to kp 2.25 and add a small ki (0.3) to remove steady-state drift on curves. Check max_error and line_loss_events on the failing slalom runs to tell overshoot from line loss.
requested_changes: If slalom finishes reach 17/20 or more with line_loss_events at or below 0.25: keep kp 2.0 and kd 1.2, and consider a small base_speed rise from 1.2 to 1.25 to recover completion time, since iteration 6 slalom finish times were 2.50 s.

If slalom line_loss_events rise above 0.3 or finishes fall below 15/20: return controller.kp to 2.25 and set controller.ki to 0.3, since iteration 6 at kp 2.25 gave 16/20 and kp 3.0 in iteration 5 was worse.

If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 on any track: lower controller.kd from 1.2 toward 1.0 with kp 2.0 held, since iteration 3 oscillation was 0.21 to 0.28 at kd 0.9 and iteration 5 was 0.28 to 0.30 at kd 1.2.
